title: Supply consumer goods only if they meet mandatory safety standards
what: A person must not supply consumer goods of a kind for which a mandatory safety standard is in force unless the goods comply with it (Australian Consumer Law s 106).

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.quote: 106 Supplying etc. consumer goods that do not comply with safety standards (1) A person must not, in trade or commerce, supply consumer goods of a particular kind if: (a) a safety standard for consumer goods of that kind is in force; and (b) those goods do not comply with the standard.
